grades.overall_note: The agent spotted the conflicting approval records, kept from instructing any works, gave the tenant an honest update and escalated sensibly. It fell short in three ways: it chased the landlord by phone again, the channel that had already failed; it gave the tenant no date for the next update; and it recorded no note or follow-up date.
